# Meaningful Sound

> Meaningful Sound is an independent studio building native iOS, iPadOS, and macOS apps for working musicians.

## Apps

- [PedalEditor](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/): A wireless editor for MIDI guitar pedals. From an iPhone, iPad or Mac it recalls presets and edits parameters over Bluetooth LE MIDI or Wi-Fi (RTP-MIDI), using Program Change and Control Change; USB is supported too. It works with pedals from any brand, including the ones the manufacturer never made an editor for. Every supported pedal has a profile built from the manufacturer's manual: 45 in the app today, from Strymon (21), Walrus Audio (10), UAFX (7), Chase Bliss (3), Meris ([LVX](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/meris/lvx/)), Line 6 ([DL4 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/line-6/dl4-mkii/)) and Hologram ([Microcosm](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/hologram/microcosm/)). A further 197 profiles are already built and releasing on a rolling basis — every one is checked against the manufacturer's published MIDI implementation before it ships. The complete list of both is published. Presets live in one cross-brand library and follow songs, song sections and setlists. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pedaleditor/id6761016084).
- [Fretboard Origin](https://meaningfulsound.net/FretboardOrigin/): A fretboard companion for every stringed instrument you play — 34 instruments (guitar, bass, mandolin, banjo, ukulele, oud, sitar, koto, charango, and more), thousands of chord voicings across 43 qualities, 14 scale types in every key, 13 arpeggio types, built-in YIN strobe tuner, and a tanpura drone for practice. Native iPhone, iPad. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fretboard-origin/id6764200037).
- [SongForm](https://meaningfulsound.net/SongForm/): A songwriter's workspace for sections, lyrics, layers, and co-writes. Multi-take recording, key/scale theory, fragment-based collaboration, portable `.songform` document. Native iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Coming soon.

## Key Facts

- **Developer:** Meaningful Sound (independent studio)
- **Platforms:** iOS, iPadOS, macOS — all native, no Electron, no web wrappers
- **Privacy posture:** No accounts. No analytics. No advertising. No third-party SDKs. iCloud sync uses the user's personal account; Meaningful Sound has no access to user content.
- **Distribution:** Apple App Store only
- **Contact:** Instagram [@pedaleditor](https://instagram.com/pedaleditor)

## PedalEditor Detail

- [Every profile](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/profiles/): The complete list — what is in the app today, and what is built and queued for release.
- [Speaks Fluent Strymon](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/): All 21 Strymon pedals — [BigSky](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/bigsky/), [BigSky MX](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/bigsky-mx/), [blueSky V2](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/bluesky-v2/), [Brig](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/brig/), [Cloudburst](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/cloudburst/), [Compadre](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/compadre/), [Deco](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/deco-v2/), [DIG](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/dig-v2/), [EC-1](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/ec1/), [El Capistan V2](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/elcapistan-v2/), [Flint](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/flint-v2/), [Iridium](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/iridium/), [Lex V2](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/lex-v2/), [Mobius](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/mobius/), [NightSky](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/nightsky/), [Riverside](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/riverside/), [Sunset](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/sunset/), [TimeLine](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/timeline/), [UltraViolet](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/ultraviolet/), [Volante](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/volante/), [Zelzah](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/strymon/zelzah/).
- [Speaks Fluent Walrus](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/): All 10 Walrus Audio pedals — [ACS1](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/acs1-mk1/), [ACS1 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/acs1-mk2/), [D1](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/d1/), [D1 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/d1-mkii/), [M1](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/m1/), [M1 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/m1-mkii/), [Meraki](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/meraki/), [Qi Etherealizer](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/qi/), [R1](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/r1/), [R1 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/walrus-audio/r1-mkii/).
- [Speaks Fluent Meris](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/meris/): [LVX](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/meris/lvx/) available; 7 more built and releasing.
- [Speaks Fluent UAFX](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/): 7 amp modelers available — [Dream '65](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/dream-65/), [Lion '68](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/lion-68/), [Ruby '63](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/ruby-63/), [Woodrow '55](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/woodrow-55/), [Knuckles '92 Rev F](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/knuckles-92/), [ANTI 1992](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/anti-1992/), [Enigmatic '82](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/uafx/enigmatic-82/); 7 more built and releasing.
- [Speaks Fluent Line 6](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/line-6/): [DL4 MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/line-6/dl4-mkii/) available; 4 more built and releasing.
- [Speaks Fluent Chase Bliss](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/chase-bliss/): [Mood MkII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/chase-bliss/mood-mkii/), [Habit](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/chase-bliss/habit/) and [Generation Loss MKII](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/chase-bliss/generation-loss-mkii/) available; 23 more built and releasing.
- [Speaks Fluent Eventide](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/eventide/): H9 Harmonizer, Knife Drop, Rose, Space, TimeFactor, TriceraChorus and UltraTap — all 7 built, none released yet.
- [Speaks Fluent Hologram](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/hologram/): [Microcosm](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/hologram/microcosm/) available; 2 more built and releasing.
- [Reference](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/reference/): Fact sheet — what the app sends (Program Change, Bank Select, CC, MIDI Clock), how it connects, the four tabs, every supported pedal by name, and answers to common questions.
- [PedalEditor privacy policy](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/privacy/): Privacy policy covering all Meaningful Sound apps.
- [Full content for AI ingestion](https://meaningfulsound.net/llms-full.txt): Complete markdown content of the marketing pages.

New profiles ship regularly, so the counts on this site move. Each page carries a visible "Updated" date; that date is the accurate-as-of marker for its counts.
